items.q: What is the period of a wave?
items.qAf: Wat is die periode van ’n golf?
options: The number of waves per second
The time for one complete wave to pass a point
optionsAf: Die tyd vir een volledige golf om ’n punt te bereik
items.explain: Period T is the time for one complete wave cycle; T = 1 ÷ f.
items.explainAf: Periode T is die tyd vir een volledige golfsiklus; T = 1 ÷ f.

items.q: A wave has frequency 20 Hz and wavelength 0.5 m. What is its speed?
items.qAf: ŉ Golf het frekwensie 20 Hz en golflengte 0,5 m. Wat is sy spoed?

items.q: Sound and light: which travels faster in air?
items.qAf: Klank en lig: watter beweeg vinniger in lug?
items.explain: Light travels at about 300 000 km/s; sound in air is about 340 m/s.
items.explainAf: Lig beweeg ongeveer 300 000 km/s; klank in lug is ongeveer 340 m/s.

items.q: Which part of the electromagnetic spectrum has the longest wavelength?
items.qAf: Watter deel van die elektromagnetiese spektrum het die langste golflengte?
items.explain: Radio waves have the longest wavelengths and the lowest frequencies.
items.explainAf: Radiogolwe het die langste golflengtes en die laagste frekwensies.

items.q: Which type of radiation is used in cell phones and Wi-Fi?
items.qAf: Watter soort straling word in selfone en Wi-Fi gebruik?
items.explain: Mobile phones and Wi-Fi use radio and microwave frequencies.
items.explainAf: Selfone en Wi-Fi gebruik radio- en mikrogolffrekwensies.

items.q: Why are ultraviolet waves harmful to skin, while radio waves are not?
items.qAf: Waarom is ultraviolet golwe skadelik vir die vel, terwyl radiogolwe nie is nie?
options: UV has higher energy per photon
optionsAf: UV het hoër energie per foton
items.explain: Higher-frequency waves carry more energy per photon, which can damage cells.
items.explainAf: Hoër-frekwensie golwe dra meer energie per foton, wat selle kan beskadig.
